korean.name: Korean skincare
korean.what: Many thin, hydrating layers: toner, essence, serum, cream. Clay’s K-beauty mode and “thinnest to thickest” order come from here.
korean.note: Ten steps aren’t required. Clay offers a balanced 4–6 step version.

indian.name: Indian hair care
indian.what: Weekly scalp oiling with amla, bhringraj, coconut or sesame oil, massaged in before washing.
indian.note: Coming with hair care, the first extension after the face routine.

african.name: West African body care
african.what: Raw shea butter to seal in moisture, and black soap made from plantain ash and oils.
african.note: Black soap is alkaline and can dry or sting the face. Clay suggests it for the body, and patch-testing first.

arab.name: Arab perfumery
arab.what: Concentrated attar oils, oud, rose and amber, often layered under spray fragrance, and bakhoor smoke for hair and clothes.
arab.note: Lives in the Scent builder, body only.
